title: Asset Pack Manifest
description: Fully describes one immutable version of an asset pack: identity, every file with its content hash, and the ordered entry points the shell loads. A file absent from this manifest is not part of the pack. See openspec change asset-pack-system, capability pack-manifest.

format_version.description: Manifest format version. Clients MUST refuse (not partially interpret) any manifest whose format_version exceeds what they support.

id.description: Internal registry identifier, Rule 11 grammar: pack:<namespace>.<object_name>, lowercase snake_case.

purl.description: Standard package-URL of the external origin this pack was generated from, when one exists (e.g. pkg:npm/%40dufeut/xkin@0.1.0).

files.description: Complete enumeration of the pack's files. Verification fails if any listed file is missing or mismatched, or if unlisted files are present in the staged tree.

entry.description: Ordered entry points the shell loads; tags are generated from these, never hand-written.

scripts.description: Script entry points, in load order. Each MUST match a path listed in files.

styles.description: Stylesheet entry points, in load order. Each MUST match a path listed in files.

relative_path.description: Forward-slash relative path inside the pack: no leading slash, no drive letter, no '.' or '..' segments, no backslashes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file content; also its key in the content-addressed store.
